title: Monomorphism
description: JSON Schema for a monomorphism — a morphism f : A → B that is left-cancellable: f ∘ g = f ∘ h implies g = h for every parallel pair g, h : X → A (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §5; Awodey 2010 §2.1). The categorical generalization of injectivity; in Set the monomorphisms are exactly the injections. Specializes transformer by structural property; the cancellability law is universally quantified over parallel pairs and lives in transformer-check territory.
